basic_info.description: Welcome to your 14th floor sanctuary at Arden's coveted Tower Residenceboasting stunning bay views and all-day sun from the southern exposure. This 2BD/2BA condo features a smart split-bedroom layout, upgraded in-unit washer/dryer, premium carpet in bedrooms, and window coverings with custom roller shades in the living room and Hunter Douglas honeycomb shades in the bedrooms. Kitchen is outfitted with Caesarstone counters, Thermador appliances, gas range & vented hood. Spacious primary suite offers dual-vanity, separate tub & shower, and powered washlet. Guest bath includes tub over shower. Enjoy central heat & AC, a large private balcony, and 1-car garage parking with EV charger installed. Resort-style amenities include 24hr concierge, two gyms (Peloton cardio room + weights room), 75ft heated pool, hot tub, resident lounges, BBQs, pet spa, EV charging, Laundry Locker, and extra storage. Live along Mission Creek near trails, dog parks, Gus's, SPARK Social, UCSF, Chase Center & HQs like OpenAI, Scale AI, Lyft & Uber.
